prompt: What is the name of the Welsh nurse who specializes in palliative care and was elected Fellow of the Learned Society of Wales in 2011?
answer: The name is **Professor Mari Lloyd-Williams**. She specializes in palliative care and was elected a Fellow of the Learned Society of Wales in 2011. (She is a medical consultant rather than a nurse.)
